note: Raiffeisenbank's tariffs for the current accounts its credit cards are issued to (in force from 24 September 2026), read in full, with the three cards' own pages: the MIR 110 Credit card ('110 дней'), the MIR CASHBACK Credit ('Кэшбэк на всё') and the MIR CASHBACK Supreme Credit ('Кэшбэк на всё Премиум'). Each card: purchases (the bank's grace-eligible operations) at 19% to 41.5% a year, the bank setting each holder's rate within the range on its credit assessment; cash, transfers and other non-grace operations at 19% to 49% a year; a cash withdrawal fee of 3% of the sum plus 300 roubles (the 110 card's first 50,000 roubles a month free and the Cashback cards' dearer 3.9% plus 390 roubles at other banks' machines aren't modelled, the fee charged as at the bank's own); 1.65% on spending abroad in another currency. The Supreme card's processing fee is 1,490 roubles a year or nothing, the figure the bank tells each holder (free within Premium Banking, a condition the game doesn't check), so it is charged in full. Minimum payment: 3% of the debt at the statement date (the 110 card's page) and of the principal (the Cashback card's page); the Supreme card's page gives 'up to 5%', not written. Grace: up to 52 days on purchases for the two Cashback cards; the 110 card's 110 days (three payment periods) is beyond the 90 days the game's form allows and isn't written. The penalty of 20% a year on the overdue debt, charged on top of the interest when a minimum payment is missed, isn't one of the form's terms and isn't written. The notification, cash deposit and rate-reduction fees aren't written. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no bank was added. Sberbank, VTB, Alfa-Bank, T-Bank, Rosbank, Sovcombank, Promsvyazbank, MTS Bank, Pochta Bank, Home Credit, Uralsib, Ak Bars, Rosselkhozbank, Bank Saint Petersburg, MKB, VBRR, Lockobank and Absolut Bank didn't answer from this network; Gazprombank and Renaissance Credit answered 403; OTP Bank and Yandex Bank answered with a captcha; Russian Standard's tariff plan for its Mir 100+ credit card (ТП 167-н) and the card's page were read, but neither gives an interest rate (the page says it is set individually on each application), so the card can't be written; UniCredit Bank's credit cards are now only for existing holders.
